'''Joy''' was one of five [[Force Priestesses/Legends|Force Priestesses]] who had sustained their consciousness in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] after [[Death/Legends|death]] and dwelt inside the [[Wellspring of Life/Legends|Force planet]].
